questions.stem_text: Does increased nerve length within the treatment volume improve trigeminal neuralgia radiosurgery?
questions.answer_explanation: Increasing the treatment volume to include a longer nerve length for trigeminal neuralgia radiosurgery does not significantly improve pain relief but may increase complications.

questions.stem_text: Is robotically assisted laparoscopic radical prostatectomy less invasive than retropubic radical prostatectomy?
questions.answer_explanation: This study showed for the first time that RALP induces lower tissue trauma than RRP.

questions.stem_text: Is gastric electrical stimulation superior to standard pharmacologic therapy in improving GI symptoms, healthcare resources, and long-term health care benefits?
questions.answer_explanation: We conclude that GES is more effective in improving long-term GI symptoms and costs, and decreasing use of healthcare resources than intensive medical therapy, in this sample of patients with the symptoms of GP followed for 3 years. Certain patients with GP form a high-risk group in terms of costs, quality of life, morbidity and mortality.

questions.stem_text: Juvenile osteochondritis dissecans: is it a growth disturbance of the secondary physis of the epiphysis?
questions.answer_explanation: MRI of children with OCD consistently showed secondary physis disruption, overlying chondroepiphysial widening, and subchondral bone edema. We suggest that disruption of normal endochondral ossification may be associated with juvenile OCD.

questions.stem_text: Does binge drinking during early pregnancy increase the risk of psychomotor deficits?
questions.answer_explanation: In this study, we found no systematic association between isolated episodes of binge drinking during early pregnancy and child motor function at age 5.
